entry.name: Entry & Registration
entry.how: FC College Gate 2 on FC Road. Registration desks are just inside the gate.

commercial.name: Commercial Stalls
commercial.how: Straight ahead from FC College Gate 2. Stalls line both sides of the walkway: Pathway 1 (A and B stalls) comes first, followed by Pathway 2 (C and D stalls).

startup.name: Youth Startup Zone
startup.how: Walk through the commercial stalls to the junction and turn left. The Youth Startup Zone is on your left, just past the junction.

kimaya.name: Kimaya
kimaya.how: At the junction after the commercial stalls, turn right and follow the road to its end.

art.name: Art & Craft Experience Zone
art.how: At the junction, turn right, then take the first left. The Art & Craft Zone is on your right.

amphitheatre.name: N. M. Wadia Amphitheatre
amphitheatre.how: At the junction, turn right and take the first left past the Art & Craft Zone. At the end, turn left. The Amphitheatre entrance is on your right. The direct road from the junction is closed.

food.name: Food Court
food.how: Follow the route towards the Amphitheatre, continue to the main road and turn right. The Food Court is on your left.

mainstage.name: Main Stage
mainstage.how: Follow the route towards the Amphitheatre, continue to the main road and turn right. The Main Stage is on your right, inside Fergusson College Ground.

experience.name: Experience Zone
experience.how: Follow the route towards the Amphitheatre, continue to the main road and turn right. Enter Fergusson College Ground on your right, the same entrance as the Main Stage. The Experience Zone is on the far side of the ground.
